title: Page 239
transc:
Ft Monroe Sept. 16 / 64
Maj. Eckert Washington
Snake A Pea gas for Lieut. pandora M. R.
Morgan appian unity The rose at daylight this morning
made a raid upon the general herd at Coggins
Point and pewtered it entire peach waldo penny prolong
and mother pledge head zebra I wrangle you not
knowing how many you will send for zodiac The
lines are down between here and animal yoke Thomas
Wilson Lieut. paradise and Sheaf see S Please forward
to cancer zebra another from Animal Lucy gift for
pandora M. R. Morgan Camel zebra The above dispatch
just received unity we have flood wine head on
hand walrus M. P. small Lieut paradise see S.
Geo. D. Sheldon


Fort Monroe Sept 16 / 64
G. J. Lawrence Harpers Ferry
Silver a Pea gift for Lieut. pandora Morgan cancer zebra
The rome made a raid on the cattle herd near
Coggins Point & piloted the entire herd harsh pension william
and marriage plague head zodiac The Lines are down and
you will have to order by wreathe from Animal youth
Thomas Wilson Lieut paradise and C. S. add following from
Appian Libby unity The above telegram was received from Lieut
paradise Wilson zebra I will send forbid wine head tomorrow
yoke M. P. small Lieut Kernel and C. S. finis .
Geo. D. Sheldon
